name: QRcdr – Advanced QR Code Generator
author: Nicola Franchini

sections.description:
Transform Your WordPress Site with the Ultimate Frontend QR Code Generator.

Elevate your website’s functionality and user engagement by integrating a professional, feature-rich QR code generator directly into your pages or posts. The QRcdr WordPress plugin allows your visitors to effortlessly create highly customizable static QR codes right from your site’s frontend, all powered by the acclaimed QRcdr script.

QRcdr offers unparalleled ease of integration, allowing you to embed a complete, interactive QR code creation studio into any page or post. Your users can then intuitively design unique, high-quality static QR codes for a multitude of purposes, significantly enhancing their engagement and experience on your site.

While the free version provides an exceptional tool for your visitors, professionals, and businesses looking for advanced capabilities will discover a new level of power with QRcdr PRO.

👉 Try the online demo and see it in action!

🚀 UNLOCK ADVANCED POTENTIAL: Introducing QRcdr PRO – Your Dynamic QR Marketing Suite

Take your digital strategy to the next level. QRcdr PRO empowers you to create powerful, trackable, and dynamic QR code campaigns. Ideal for businesses, marketers, and agencies, the PRO version transforms your QR codes into intelligent, data-driven assets.

Experience the cutting-edge PRO features, designed for unparalleled flexibility and insight:

  • Dynamic QR Codes: Change the destination URL or content anytime, even after printing. Update links, promotions, or information without reprinting codes.
  • Comprehensive Scan Analytics: Gain valuable insights into your QR code performance. Track every scan, including location, time, device type, and more.
  • Advanced QR Types & Templates: Access exclusive, business-focused QR code types like:
    • Digital Menus for restaurants and cafes
    • Time-sensitive Coupons and Vouchers
    • vCard Plus with extended contact details
    • Feedback forms, Wi-Fi login, and many more specialized options.
  • User Subscriptions & SaaS Mode: Build your own QR code generation platform! Offer premium plans, manage users, and create a recurring revenue stream by providing a QR code as a service (SaaS) directly from your WordPress site.
  • Personalized Templates: Save and reuse your custom QR code designs for consistent branding and faster creation.

Learn more and prepare for launch at qrcdr.pro! Don’t miss out on the future of QR code marketing.

✨ Key Features of the Free QRcdr Plugin:

  • Frontend QR Code Generator: Empower your users to create QR codes directly on your website.
  • Seamless Gutenberg Integration: Easily add the QR code generator block to any page or post.
  • Versatile Shortcode Support: Use [qrcdr] to embed the generator anywhere, including classic editor or widgets.
  • Unlimited Static QR Codes: Users can generate an infinite number of permanent, reliable QR codes.
  • Extensive Visual Customization Options:
    • Primary Color & Gradient Options: Set distinct colors for the QR code body and background.
    • Pattern Customization: Choose from various shapes and styles for the QR code body and eye patterns.
    • Custom Logo Upload: Allow users to embed their own brand logo directly into the center of the QR code.
    • Designer Frames & Text: Select from pre-made frames and add custom text to make QR codes truly stand out.
  • 14+ Supported Data Types (QR Code Content): Offer a wide array of content options for diverse needs:
    • Website Link (URL)
    • Plain Text
    • E-mail Address
    • Location (Google Maps link)
    • Phone Number
    • SMS Message
    • WhatsApp Message
    • Skype Call
    • Zoom Meeting Link
    • Wi-Fi Network Credentials
    • V-Card (Standard Digital Business Card)
    • Event (iCalendar file)
    • PayPal Checkout Link
    • Bitcoin Transaction
  • High-Resolution, Print-Ready Downloads: Users can download their custom QR codes in superior quality PNG, SVG, and PDF formats, ensuring perfect clarity for both digital and print applications.

External Services

This plugin uses OpenStreetMap services to display maps and locate coordinates.

OpenStreetMap (Map Tiles)
* Service: Provides the graphical map tiles used in the “Location” tab.
* Used for: Displaying the map so users can pick a location.
* Data sent: When the map loads, the user’s browser makes requests to OpenStreetMap servers. This transmits standard request data (IP address, User Agent) to retrieve the map images.
* Privacy Policy: https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy
* Terms: https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

Nominatim (Address Search)
* Service: OpenStreetMap’s geocoding service.
* Used for: Converting the text address entered by the user into geographic coordinates (Latitude/Longitude).
* Data sent: The address string typed by the user is sent to Nominatim servers via an API request.
* Privacy Policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy
* Usage Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/

Copyright

  • Default maps data provided by: OpenStreetMap under ODbL.
sections.installation:
1. Download the qrcdr plugin and upload the folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP or WordPress uploader.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. To display the generator, navigate to the page or post where you want to add it.
  4. In the Gutenberg editor, click the ‘+’ icon to add a new block and search for ‘QRcdr’. Insert the block and customize its options (e.g., primary color, default services).
  5. Alternatively, you can paste the [qrcdr] shortcode into any text area, classic editor, or widget that supports shortcodes.
sections.faq:
Q: Why should I add a QR code generator to my WordPress site?

A: By offering a high-quality, free-to-use QR code maker directly on your site, you significantly increase its value to visitors, boost engagement, and encourage repeat visits. It transforms your website into a practical utility, providing a useful tool that your audience will appreciate and utilize.

Q: What is a static QR Code and how does it differ?

A: A static QR code directly embeds the destination data (like a URL, text, or vCard) into its pattern. Once created, the information cannot be changed. It’s highly reliable, permanent, and ideal for content that won’t require updates. The free QRcdr plugin specializes in creating these robust static QR codes.

Q: Can I create dynamic or trackable QR Codes with this plugin?

A: The free QRcdr plugin is dedicated to generating high-quality static QR codes. For the ability to create dynamic (editable) QR codes, implement scan analytics, and access advanced business-oriented types like Digital Menus, Coupons, and Feedback Forms, you’ll need the upcoming QRcdr PRO plugin. Stay informed about the launch and features at https://qrcdr.pro.

Q: Is the frontend generator user-friendly for my website visitors?

A: Absolutely. The QRcdr generator features a clean, intuitive, and highly responsive user interface. It’s designed to seamlessly guide users through the entire process of creating and customizing their QR codes, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable experience.

Q: Do my visitors need an account or registration to create QR codes?

A: No, the frontend QR code generator in the free version is fully accessible to all public visitors on the page where you place it. No accounts or registrations are required, making it incredibly easy for anyone to use.

Q: What download formats are available for the generated QR codes?

A: Users can download their custom QR codes in versatile, high-resolution formats: PNG, SVG, and PDF. This ensures excellent quality for any digital display or print media application.

Q: Can I customize the appearance of the QR code generator block on my site?

A: Yes! The QRcdr Gutenberg block comes with various configurable options, allowing you to set the primary color, choose available QR code types (services), and define the layout, ensuring it perfectly matches your website’s design.
